# A plain Go dependency the export does not copy keeps its same-named
# user calls: the text rewrite never touches its files, so the eject
# check verifies portability only and the export succeeds instead of
# refusing the call as ambiguous.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd kdmain
logos run .
stdout '^kdmain ready: 4$'
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! exists out/_logos_deps/example.com/h2kddep@v0.0.0
cd out
go build ./...
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
go run .
stdout '^kdmain ready: 4$'
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
stdout '^kdmain ready: 4$'
cd ../..

-- kddep/go.mod --
module example.com/h2kddep

go 1.27

-- kddep/meter.go --
package kddep

// Meter is a user type with the same opt-in name as the fork-only
// (*net/http.Server) method. The export never copies this dependency,
// so the rewrite cannot steal the call and the check must not refuse it.
type Meter struct{ Hits int }

func (m *Meter) EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect() { m.Hits++ }

-- kddep/dep.go --
package kddep

import "net/http"

func Serve() int {
	m := &Meter{}
	m.EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect()
	return len(http.MethodGet) + m.Hits
}

-- kdmain/go.mod --
module example.com/h2kdmain

go 1.27

require example.com/h2kddep v0.0.0

replace example.com/h2kddep => ../kddep

-- kdmain/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/h2kddep"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println("kdmain ready:", kddep.Serve())
}
